suggestions: I'm grateful for a bug report that actually came with steps to reproduce, for once.
I'm thankful for the surau being two minutes from my desk when it's time for Zohor.
I'm grateful for leftover rendang that somehow tastes even better cold from the fridge.
I'm thankful for a Slack message that said "no rush" and actually meant it.
I'm grateful for the LRT showing up on time the one morning I was already running late.
I'm thankful for my dad calling just to ask if I've eaten, nothing else on the agenda.
I'm grateful for staging catching the thing before it ever touched production.
I'm thankful for the breeze through the window at six, right before the heat sets in.
I'm grateful for a teammate who stayed back to pair on a deploy I would've been nervous doing alone.
I'm thankful for sitting still for a minute after Isyak before getting up to do anything else.
I'm grateful for a landlord who actually fixed the leaking pipe the same day I messaged him.
I'm thankful for finding a parking spot right outside the kopitiam during the lunch rush.
I'm grateful for a sprint that matched the estimate, no last-minute scope creep sneaking in.
I'm thankful for my sister dropping memes in the family group chat at the exact moment I needed to laugh.
I'm grateful for waking up a few minutes before the alarm and just lying there in the quiet.
